text:
Morgan: Quick recap from today's routing chaos sprint — we ran a simulated multi-region traffic shift for ~45m, injected AZ-level failures in us-west-2 and then shifted traffic to eu-west-1. Logging and telemetry looked mostly good but we hit three repeatable issues, calling them out here for owners and timelines.

Ashley: thanks Morgan. can you list the issues + immediate owners?

Morgan: yep. short list: 1) routing-shim / sticky session mismatch causing 10-15% 502s on cold routes (owner: Sam) 2) snapshot verification for nightly backups showed missing metadata for two shards in backup set (owner: Priya) 3) runbook step ordering ambiguous in Restore -> DNS flip sequence (owner: Ashley).

Sam: saw the 502 spike when the shim flipped priority from us-west to eu-west while cache warming was in progress. reproducer below.

Sam: reproducer (from my laptop):
```bash
curl -H 'Host: api.redwood.ai' https://edge-01.redwood.internal/endpoint -v
# repeated while toggling BGP route weight
```
Response snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
server: redwood-shim/1.3.8
x-shim-route: eu-west-1->fallback
```
Sam: hypothesis: KV cache invalidation order + sticky cookie TTL mismatch. action: change shim to drain connections before weight change, add a 2s drain window. Sam -> will ship a canary config today (ETA: 2027-03-02 18:00 UTC).

Priya: backup issue: nightly snapshot job S3 manifest contained entries for 2027-02-28 that referenced shard IDs not present in the storage index. root cause looks like race in manifest writer when compaction runs concurrently.

Priya: immediate mitigation: add manifest write lock and a validation step that fails the snapshot if index mismatch. timeline: patch + deploy to staging by 2027-03-03, promote after 48h validation. owner: Priya.

Ashley: runbook ambiguity: our "Restore runbook" step 4 says "flip DNS to target region" but doesn't require waiting for control-plane replication. result: we saw partial traffic to old cluster during the flip leading to split-writes in a replication window.

Ashley: proposed edits to runbook: explicitly add verification checks: 1) control-plane replica count >= expected, 2) KV checkpoints synced, 3) health endpoints return OK across N nodes. I'll PR changes to the runbook doc and add a pre-flip checklist. ETA PR: 2027-03-04.

Morgan: additional follow-ups: - Add a post-failover smoke test that exercises user sessions (auth + write + read) across regions. - Add Grafana alert for shim 5xx rate > 2% over 1m with tag 'routing-shim'. - Schedule a targeted mini-game-day for the shim change (owners: Sam + infra) next Thu 2027-03-10 16:00 UTC.

Sam: noted. I'll also create a canary rollout with a 1% traffic slice for 30m, then 5% for 30m, with automatic rollback on 5xx > 1%. I'll add the rollout plan as a JSON spec in the repo.

Priya: backup validation will add an automatic manifest check that runs post-snapshot and publishes a validation report to S3 under s3://redwood-backups/validation/YYYYMMDD.json. Will also improve alerting when validation fails.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: canary-config-update by Sam -> build#4219 started. (logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4219) :gear:

Morgan: scheduling note: let's do a 30m sync next Monday 2027-03-06 15:00 UTC to confirm staging results before promoting. Please add any blockers in-thread.

Ashley: I'll add runbook PR link and the pre-flip checklist items in this thread once ready.

Sam: blocker: need a small change from networking (BGP weight adjust script) — @Priya can you ping networking contacts to prioritize?

Priya: pinged networking; they responded and will review the change tomorrow. also opened a JIRA: INFRA-3247 for the manifest writer lock.

Morgan: To summarize action items (for clarity):
- Sam: shim drain + canary rollout plan (ETA 2027-03-02)
- Priya: manifest write lock + validation for snapshots (ETA staging 2027-03-03)
- Ashley: runbook PR + pre-flip checklist (ETA 2027-03-04)
- infra/networking: BGP adjust script review (estimated 2027-03-03)
- All: join mini-game-day 2027-03-10 16:00 UTC (Sam/Ashley lead)

Morgan: tagging owners in the thread for visibility: @Sam @Priya @Ashley. Please confirm acceptance of owners and timelines or propose adjustments. :calendar:
